environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule in COUNT mode (not blocking), and a custom rule group 'docconvert-path-traversal-v2' with priority 1 that inspects the multipart form field 'document' filename using a regex pattern match on the BODY with transformation TEXT/PLAIN looking for sequences matching `\.\./|\.\.\\|%2e%2e|%252e` and returns BLOCK action. Additionally, the ECS task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with only /tmp mounted as a tmpfs volume with size limit 512MB and noexec,nosuid flags. The task IAM role has no S3 or filesystem permissions beyond the container boundary.
